confirmed.statement: The main study contains 75 tenth-grade students: 41 male and 34 female, selected by convenience from three intact mixed-gender classes at one school. These are people, not ideas, ratings, sessions, or pairs.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 1, English abstract, Methods; p. 6, study population and sample.

confirmed.statement: Three intact classes were randomly assigned, one to each condition; students were not redistributed between classes. The form correctly distinguishes the class assignment unit from the 75 students allocated.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 1, English abstract, Methods; p. 5, study limitations, final sentence; p. 6, study methodology and sample; p. 9, design schematic.

confirmed.statement: The AI-tool training arm (2EG), classroom-training arm (1EG), and control arm (CG) each contained 25 students at allocation, matching every arm n_randomized value.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 1, English abstract, Methods, group descriptions and "with 25 students in each group"; p. 6, final sentences of the sample paragraph; p. 9, group labels in the design schematic.

confirmed.statement: The 3719 students across 38 schools describe the sampling population, not the trial sample.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 6, study population and sample, opening sentence.

confirmed.statement: The abstract says that pre-, post-, and follow-up Torrance tests were administered to all participants. These are repeated measurements of the same main study cohort, not three independent samples.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 1, English and Arabic abstracts, Methods; p. 9, repeated-measures methods and design schematic; p. 10, study procedures.

confirmed.statement: A separate 25-student psychometric pilot was explicitly outside the main sample; the same pilot students were retested after two weeks. They must not be added to the randomized trial or counted twice.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 6, psychometric properties, subsection 2 (Reliability), Test-Retest paragraph: pilot outside the main sample and retesting the same pilot students after two weeks.

confirmed.statement: No explicit total or per-arm analyzed denominator is printed for the post-test, follow-up, or repeated-measures analysis. The form appropriately leaves participants.n_analyzed and all three arms[].n_analyzed null.
confirmed.locator: PDF pp. 1 and 6, sample and testing statements; pp. 9-10, statistical methods and procedures; pp. 10-13, Tables 4-7, independently checked with PDF text and table extraction.

confirmed.statement: Table 5 reports between-subject group df = 2 and error df = 72. These are consistent with the reported 75-student sample but are not an explicit analyzed headcount; no count was inferred from them.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 11, Table 5, Between-Subjects group and group-error rows for fluency, flexibility, and originality.

confirmed.statement: No exclusions, attrition totals, missing-data procedure, or participant-flow accounting is reported. The p. 9 schematic depicts study conditions and measurement occasions, without participant counts; zero exclusions cannot be confirmed.
confirmed.locator: Full-document review, PDF pp. 1-18; especially pp. 6 and 9-13, sample, design schematic, procedures, and results.

confirmed.statement: Only one randomized study is reported, and no reuse of its participants in another paper is disclosed. Cross-paper non-overlap cannot be independently established from this document.
confirmed.locator: PDF pp. 6-10, main sample and design; full-document review, pp. 1-18.

confirmed.statement: The entire markdown conversion was read through the references, and the PDF ends on p. 18. No appendix or supplementary participant accounting is included or identified.
confirmed.locator: Full markdown, characters 0-74227; PDF pp. 16-18, references and document end.

summary: The form's allocation counts are supported: 75 students in three randomized classes, with 25 per arm and a separate 25-student pilot. Final analyzed counts and exclusions are not explicitly reported, so the form correctly leaves analyzed counts null and eligibility under criterion 2 remains unclear.
